newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Jingwei A share price seen triple H shares.
newsitem.headline: Jingwei A share price seen triple H shares.

text.p: Jingwei Textile Machinery Co said on Tuesday the issue price of its 23 million class A shares to be listed in China would be about three times the HK$1.29 issue price of its Hong Kong H shares.

"The prices of several listed companies in Shanghai are over three times the issue price of our H shares. But our (financial) efficiency is much better," chairman Mei Zaisen told reporters on Tuesday.
"China's A share market is not bad," he said. "It's very good for us."
The China-incorporated company had not yet decided whether to list its A shares in Shanghai or Shenzhen, Mei added.

Proceeds of the A share issue would be used to fund a technology cooperation project on rotor spinning machines with the Czech Republic, the development of new products, technological reforms and acquisitions.
Jingwei was now negotiating the acquisition of two profit-making Chinese firms in related fields, Mei added.
